workarounds: Librarian skill unavailable in run; capability breakdown derived inline from the task statement rather than retrieved.

suggestions.assertion: Each tech stack layer gives a Recommendation, a Why/rationale, and at least one Alternative
suggestions.reason: The Third-party services and Security layers are itemized lists without the strict Recommendation/Why/Alternative triplet that the other layers follow. The assertion passes because all core layers comply, but it could be made more discriminating by specifying which layers must carry the full triplet (the format reference itself notes some layers may legitimately not need alternatives).

suggestions.assertion: Describes HOW (technologies, architecture), NOT new features or capabilities
suggestions.reason: This is hard to falsify mechanically — a discriminating version could require that any functional gap (e.g., refund policy, DRM) be explicitly deferred to solution-architect rather than decided, which all runs happen to do well but a weaker output could violate undetected.

eval_feedback.overall: Assertions are comprehensive and map well to the OUTPUT_FORMAT reference. Section-presence checks are mostly structural; the two content-quality assertions (HOW-not-WHAT, full triplet per layer) are the most valuable and could be tightened slightly.
